review.theoryObservation: All24 complete solution bodies and dependent headers checked against unchanged three steps. Three useful routes: one-part reconstruction plus error contrast, whole/missing-part reconstruction, difference-to-part reconstruction. Equal-part language, source tape model and arithmetic are Stage3; no equation-solving algebra. D3 original32 remains mathematically valid; accepted adaptation33 solely avoids fractional intermediate operations absent current taught source/parent, not mere nicer numbers or a claim all wholes must be integers.
review.sourceObservation: Personally read all3 complete closed source units: Stage3 outcomes1433-1450, build-whole1540-1551 and original OperationsFDP4 challenge5170-5182. Nonunit tape3/5 and tank3/4=81/pocketmoney2/5=6 support reversible divide-known-parts then reconstructwhole. Owned complete current equivalent-fractions parent3E and2figurecodes personally read/acknowledged. No selected original image or missing-image waiver. Denominator examples are such-as rather than a blanket prohibition on seventh/twelfth equal-part reconstruction.
